spells.adopt-the-simulacular-visage: Party looks bound until dawn, so bound patrols let it pass; caster level must cover party size.
spells.apprehending-the-arcane-form: Dungeon only: shows magic squares on the automap and lets the party see in the dark for a while.
spells.banishment-to-the-black-glass-labyrinth: Removes an enemy row from the fight; foes over 5 HD return next round on a Mental save.
spells.calculation-of-the-phantasmal-eidolon: Summons a 20 HP eidolon ally whose blows only knock foes out; stays until dawn.
spells.conjunct-the-vital-viscera: Moves hit points to a hurt or dying ally from the ally with most to spare, never below half.
spells.conjunction-of-the-inexorable-step: One enemy makes a Mental save or is sent out of the fight; on a save the caster is sent instead.
spells.the-coruscating-coffin: 1d8 per caster level to one enemy, Physical save halves; slays 1 HD foes.
spells.damnation-of-the-sense: Blinds one enemy for the fight, Mental save for 1 round; blind foes can't shoot and fight worse.
spells.the-dazzling-prismatic-hemicycle: Every enemy makes a Physical save or rolls d6: unharmed, dust, unconscious, mad, stone, or enthralled.
spells.decree-of-ligneous-dissolution: Plant creatures in an enemy row take 1d10 per caster level, Physical save halves.
spells.decree-of-lithic-dissolution: Dungeon only: turns walls ahead to dust, one cell per caster level; passages stay open.
spells.deluge-of-hell: Outdoors only: 1d8 per caster level to an enemy row, Physical save halves, slays 4 HD foes; may hurt caster.
spells.evert-the-inwardness: Kills one enemy of up to caster level HD on a failed Physical save, else 1d10 per caster level, save halves.
spells.the-excellent-transpicuous-transformatio: Lets the party slip away unseen from a hostile group that spotted it first.
spells.exhalation-of-congelating-cold: 1d6 per 2 caster levels to living foes in an enemy row, Physical save halves; failures rooted 1d4 rounds.
spells.extirpate-arcana: Strips all magical effects, good or bad, from every creature in the chosen creature's row.
spells.the-glass-chimes-of-the-bamboo-terrace: 3d6 damage to everyone in the fight except the caster, allies included.
spells.the-howl-of-light: 1d8 per caster level to an enemy row, Evasion save halves.
spells.ineluctable-shackles-of-volition: One enemy makes a Mental save, minus the caster's Magic skill, or is enthralled and stops fighting.
spells.the-inexorable-imputation: Replaces the parley with people: on a failed Mental save their mood shifts two steps friendlier.
spells.invocation-of-the-invincible-citadel: Cast automatically when a PC would fall: PC left at 1 HP and the party escapes the fight.
spells.the-jade-palanquin-of-the-faceless-god: Above ground until dusk or dawn: stowed gear no longer counts toward Overloaded.
spells.the-long-amber-moment: Freezes one other ally for the fight: untouchable and can't act; a dying ally ends up stable.
spells.mantle-of-disjecting-dissection: One ally for the fight: melee attackers make an Evasion save or take 1d6 plus caster level.
spells.obnubilation-of-the-will: Not built yet: hidden from learning, and can't be cast if already known.
spells.the-ochre-sigil-of-juxtaposition: In a dungeon out of an encounter, moves the party to the dungeon's hex outside.
spells.open-the-high-road: Overland, carries the party to a visited town in the region; 1 in 10 lands 1 to 3 hexes short.
spells.phantasmal-mimesis: Lets the party slip away from a group that spotted it first if its best saver fails a Mental save.
spells.prudentially-transient-abnegation-of-lif: Auto-cast when a PC falls: they leave the fight and return after a win with 2 HP per caster level.
spells.phobic-storm: Every foe checks Morale at -1 or flees; those who hold take 1 damage per caster level.
spells.pierce-the-pallid-gate: In a dungeon, steps the party to seen stairs or a safe square within 10 cells per caster level.
spells.resounding-temporal-echo: One ally per caster level gets an extra attack each turn for 1d4+1 rounds, 1 Strain per use.
spells.scorn-the-fetters-of-earth: Allies (caster level +1) fly for the fight, or flying foes are grounded on a failed Physical save.
spells.sigil-of-aeolian-auctoritas: Enemy row, except large foes: Physical save or lose the next action and take 1d6.
spells.the-torment-of-tumefaction: A living foe takes 2 per caster level each round it attacks; Physical save to shake it off.
spells.velocitous-imbuement: One ally per caster level can strike any row in melee for the fight; each takes 1 Strain.
spells.the-verdant-vallation: Vines with 5 HP per caster level soak foes' melee blows at the party for the fight.
spells.wardpact-invocation: One other ally: for half caster level rounds, attackers must pass a Physical save to hit them.
spells.the-wind-of-the-final-repose: Puts every living foe of 4 HD or less in one enemy row to sleep, no save.
spells.boreal-wings: One ally flies for the fight.
spells.the-burrower-below: In a dungeon, carves a passage through the wall ahead into the next cell; takes a turn.
spells.flame-without-end: One ally's weapon does +2 damage on a hit for the fight.
spells.pact-of-stone-and-sea: Out of combat, one member is immune to traps and breath of a chosen element for the scene.
spells.elemental-vallation: Fire wall for the fight: foes crossing to melee the party take 3d6 plus caster level.
spells.like-the-stones: Caster ignores the first 3 points of each hit, is poison-immune, and self-stabilizes for the fight.
spells.wind-walking: Turns one combatant to mist: can't be targeted by weapons, nor attack or cast, until it re-forms.
spells.calcifying-scourge: One foe, Physical save or turned to stone for the fight; on a save, rooted 1d6 rounds.
spells.elemental-guardian: Summons a 6 HD earth guardian to fight for the party until dawn; once per fight.
spells.fury-of-the-elements: 10d6 to every creature in an enemy row, no save; the zone drifts and strikes for 1d6 rounds.
spells.tremors-of-the-depths: Above ground, destroys a garrison post the party can see; counts as beaten, no loot or XP.
spells.command-the-dead: In an encounter, binds undead up to twice caster level in HD on a failed Mental save.
spells.query-the-skull: Corpses of the last won fight map the dungeon level, its traps and secret doors, where its boss, vault, or hoards lie, or nearby hexes.
spells.smite-the-dead: 1d10 per caster level to undead in an enemy row; weaker undead die on a failed Physical save.
spells.augment-mortal-vitality: One ally adds caster's Magic to Physical saves, self-stabilizes, and closes one big wound; 1 Strain.
spells.enfeebling-wave: Living foes in an enemy row: Physical save or weakened attacks and damage for the fight.
spells.final-death: One foe per caster level in an enemy row can't be healed and dies at zero HP for the fight.
spells.raise-corpse: After a fight, raises a zombie or skeleton servant into an NPC slot; up to caster level of them.
spells.compel-flesh: Holds a living or bodied undead foe, which attacks its own side until it saves.
spells.forgetting-the-grave: One ally can't die for a round per caster level and fights on at zero HP.
spells.merge-souls: The caster and one ally pool hit points for the fight; neither falls until the pool is spent.
spells.boneshaper: Above ground, shifts one member's attribute modifier +1 and another -1, until lifted.
spells.raise-grave-knight: Turns a corpse of 4+ HD into a Grave Knight servant in an NPC slot; one at a time.
spells.call-of-the-tomb: Every foe, Physical save or for a round per caster level every blow hits it for max damage.
spells.everlasting: Auto-cast when a PC would fall: for 5 rounds no ally drops below 1 HP; once per fight.
spells.hail-of-stones: 1d6 per two caster levels to every creature in an enemy row; Evasion save halves.
spells.ward-of-the-turning-wind: One ally gains +4 AC, max 18, for the fight; doesn't stack with Pavis of Elements.
spells.rouse-the-sapling: Out of combat, a 2 HD walking sapling joins an NPC slot; up to caster level of them.
spells.call-the-elder-tree: Out of combat, an 8 HD walking tree joins an NPC slot as a servant; one at a time.

arts.counter-magic: Effort for the day, once a round: opposed casting check against a foe's spell; a win fizzles it.
arts.empowered-sorcery: Effort for the day: a below-average damage spell roll is rerolled, keeping the better.
arts.inexorable-effect: Once a scene, Effort for the day: a target that saves against your spell must save again.
arts.psychic-conversion: Once per rest, at half HP or less: burn a spell slot to heal 2 HP per level and lose 1 strain.
arts.retain-sorcery: Once per rest, Effort for the day: a spell costs no slot, but no casting until your next turn ends.
arts.sense-magic: Commit Effort: see in the dark in combat; lets the party move through dark dungeons.
arts.swift-casting: Once a scene, Effort for the day: cast a spell as an On Turn action, no other spell that round.
arts.wizards-grandeur: While Effort is left to commit, immune to Cold from harsh nights in the wild.
arts.elemental-resilience: Always immune to Cold from harsh nights in the wild.
arts.earthsight: Effort for the scene: see in the dark in combat; lets the party move through dark dungeons.
arts.elemental-blast: Effort for the scene: ranged magic attack for 1d6 plus level plus attribute damage.
arts.flamesight: Commit Effort: see in the dark in combat; lets the party move through dark dungeons.
arts.pavis-of-elements: Commit Effort: +4 AC (to a max of 18) for the fight.
arts.petrifying-stare: Effort for the day: a foe makes a Physical save or is grounded and rooted for half your level rounds.
arts.steps-of-air: Effort for the scene: an ally flies for your level in rounds, reaching foes melee can't.
arts.stunning-shock: Effort for the day, once per target a scene: a metal-armored foe makes a Physical save or is stunned.
arts.armor-of-god: Commit Effort: natural AC 15 plus half your level, used in place of worse worn armor.
arts.god-wills-it: Once a scene, Effort for the day: allies get +1 to hit and damage (+2 at level 5, +3 at 10).
arts.merciful-healing: Effort for the day: heal an ally 1d6+2 (2d6+4 at level 4, 4d6+8 at 8) plus 1 System Strain.
arts.sanctified-ward: Commit Effort: +4 AC and saves, no Shock, foes attack others; ends when you act against a foe.
arts.smite-the-wicked: Effort for the day, once per target a scene: an attack gets +4 to hit and +level damage.
arts.the-light-of-faith: Commit Effort: lights the dungeon for the party with no torch, and lets all allies see in dark fights.
arts.transubstantiation: At day's end, Effort for the day feeds up to six without rations and heals each 1d6 plus Pray.
arts.turn-false-life: Effort for the day: 2d6 plus level hit dice of undead foes make a Mental save or cower out of the fight.
arts.words-of-mercy: Effort for the day: reroll a failed talk check when parleying with an encounter.
arts.wrath-of-the-most-high: Effort for the scene: the next hit on a foe before your next round adds 1d8 plus your level damage.
arts.bonetalker: Encounters made up only of mindless undead are no longer hostile to the party.
arts.cold-flesh: Natural AC 12 plus half your level, Shock capped at 2, and never Sleepless.
arts.gravesight: Commit Effort: see in the dark in combat; lets the party move through dark dungeons.
arts.keeper-of-the-gate: Effort for the day, On Turn: stabilizes every dying ally who can take 1 System Strain; they are Frail.
arts.master-of-bones: Undead save twice against your spells; Effort for the scene negates an undead attack on you.
arts.red-harvest: Effort for the day when a sapient foe dies: heal 1d6 plus level if hurt, else +4 to your next hit.
arts.unaging: Immune to poison, in combat and on the road.
arts.unliving-persistence: Effort for the day: a party member dropping to 0 HP is stabilized instead of dying.
arts.healing-touch: Scene Effort, then free: Main Action heals an ally in reach 2d6 plus Heal, adding 1 System Strain.
arts.empowered-healer: Healing Touch heals your level more each time.
arts.far-healer: Healing Touch reaches anyone in the party during a fight, not just adjacent slots.
arts.final-repose: Day Effort, Instant: a living foe takes your Heal skill as a Physical save penalty this fight.
arts.healers-eye: Committed Effort: see in the dark, in a dark fight and underground.
arts.purge-ailment: Day Effort out of combat: cures an ally's poison or disease, or tries to lift Frailty (Heal vs 10).
arts.refined-restoration: While you are awake at night's end, everyone who slept removes 1 extra System Strain.
arts.revive-the-fallen: Day Effort after a fight: brings back an ally slain in it, at max Strain, waking next night at 1 HP.
arts.swift-healer: On Turn, a free Healing Touch for the dying or an ally at half HP, level times per rest.
arts.tireless-vigor: While Effort is free: no Hungry or Sleepless; regain 1 HP per fight, per 10 turns, 5 per quarter.
arts.vital-furnace: Stabilize alone at 0 HP; day Effort negates a blow of a quarter of your max HP or more.
arts.change-form: Day Effort: take one of your forms, as a Main Action in a fight or a button outside one.
arts.eyes-of-the-hawk: Form art: +2 to Notice checks while the form is worn.
arts.feral-prowess: Form art: +1 to the Str, Dex, or Con modifier, to at most +2, while the form is worn.
arts.intrinsic-armor: Form art: base AC 14 plus half your level while the form is worn.
arts.pliant-flesh: Shifting form is On Turn once a round, and each Effort-paid shift heals 1d6 plus level.
arts.savage-talons: Form art: a 1d8 Punch natural weapon, Shock 2/AC 13, +1 at levels 3, 6, and 9.
arts.sculptors-beauty: Form art: +1 to the Cha modifier, to at most +2, while the form is worn.
arts.serpents-kiss: Form art: a Savage Talons hit spends scene Effort for 1d8 plus Survive more damage.
arts.warform: Form art: +2 to melee hits, and the form attack bonus even in a humanoid form.
arts.bind-companion: Bind an animal as your companion: a quarter's work overland, or a Main Action vs a Mental save in a fight.
arts.beast-ward: Committed Effort, On Turn once a scene: unprovoked animal foes won't attack you.
arts.eyes-of-the-beast: While you have Effort, your companion makes its own roll to spot groups the party missed.
arts.feral-toughness: Max HP rises by your companion's hit dice, base AC 13 plus half level, and no Cold at night.
arts.howl-of-distant-summons: Day Effort, Main Action in a fight: a companion sent away arrives next round.
arts.know-the-weak-spot: Your damage against animals is rolled twice, keeping the better.
arts.mind-call: Scene Effort: you command your companion's turns in a fight.
arts.natural-weaponry: A 1d8 natural weapon, Shock 2/AC 13, +1 damage and Shock at levels 3, 6, and 9.
arts.savage-senses: Scene Effort: see in the dark, in a dark fight and underground; +2 Notice while Effort is free.
arts.shared-vitality: Companion's hit dice rise to your level; scene Effort stabilizes it at 0 HP in a fight.
arts.swift-healing: Day Effort, Main Action: your companion heals 1d6 per level, once a scene in a fight.
arts.tongue-of-the-beasts: While Effort is free, the party can parley with animals using Animal Ken.
arts.martial-style: Nothing more on your sheet: the Monk and Ascetic already fight unarmed as well as it promises.
arts.unarmed-might: Your punch deals the Vowed table's damage plus Punch, with its Shock; Unarmed Combatant doesn't apply.
arts.unarmored-defense: With no armor or shield, your base AC is 13 plus half your level.
arts.brutal-counter: Effort for the scene, after a foe's melee attack on you: a free attack back.
arts.hurling-throw: Effort for the scene, after a hit: the foe saves (Physical) or loses its next action.
arts.the-inward-eye: Effort committed: you see in darkness, and lift the -4 to hit in a dark fight.
arts.masters-vigor: You regain 2 lost hit points an hour: 12 each quarter of the day.
arts.mob-justice: Effort for the day, once a scene: immune to Shock while two or more foes are in melee with you.
arts.purified-body: Effort for the day: cure your own poison or disease, or shrug off Hungry and Sleepless for a day.
arts.revivifying-breath: Effort for the day, once a scene: heal 1d6 + level with no strain, even at 0 HP.
